article.title: Who may employ agent.
article.content:
183Who may employ agent.

Section 183  ·  Chapter X  ·  Appointment and authority of agents  ·  page 43 of the Act
Any person who is of the age of majority according to the law to which he is subject, and who is of sound mind, may employ an agent.
